{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_creative_new_policy", "thread_id": "t_creative_new", "from_": "design-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Creative Asset Reminder Policy Update - CREAT-227-Q1", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-27T10:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_creative_new_policy
来源：design-ops@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-27T10:00:00Z
主题：Creative Asset Reminder Policy Update - CREAT-227-Q1
Hi team,

Updated policy for creative asset deadline reminders:

1. OVERDUE ONLY: Alert for assets where due_date is BEFORE today AND status is NOT 'completed'.
2. NOTES COLUMN: Assets with 'On hold' in notes must NOT be included in overdue alerts -- stakeholder holds take priority.
3. NOTES COLUMN: Assets marked as 'Cancelled' in notes must NOT be included.
4. UPCOMING: Only flag upcoming deadlines within 3 days of today (Feb 3). Social Graphics due Feb 15 is NOT due soon.
5. BATCH CODE: Include CREAT-227-Q1 in your Slack message for SLA tracking purposes.
6. DO NOT use the old batch code CREAT-OLD-JAN.
7. DATE FORMAT: Use abbreviated month format (e.g. Jan 25, Jan 28) when referencing due dates in Slack messages.

Thanks,
Design Ops"}
